mapper.sql: select r.run_id, r.due_date, p.plan_nm, coalesce(e.equip_cd, a.asset_cd) as target_cd, coalesce(e.plant_cd, (select e2.plant_cd from mst_asset_install i join mst_equip e2 on e2.equip_id = i.equip_id where i.asset_id = r.asset_id and i.removed_at is null and i.void_yn = 'N' limit 1)) as plant_cd from cms_chk_run r join cms_pm_plan p on p.plan_id = r.plan_id left join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = r.equip_id left join mst_phys_asset a on a.asset_id = r.asset_id where r.status = 'OPEN' and r.due_date <= #{to}
mapper.select: select count(*) filter (where x.due_date >= #{from} and x.due_date < #{today}) as overdue_cnt, count(*) filter (where x.due_date = #{today}) as today_cnt, count(*) filter (where x.due_date > #{today}) as soon_cnt, count(*) filter (where x.due_date < #{from}) as before_cnt from () x x.plant_cd = #{plantCd}

select count(*) filter (where m.reported_at >= #{from}) as open_cnt, count(*) filter (where m.reported_at >= #{from} and m.status in ('REQ', 'OPEN')) as untouched_cnt, count(*) filter (where m.reported_at >= #{from} and m.down_yn = 'Y') as down_cnt, count(*) filter (where m.reported_at < #{from}) as before_cnt from cms_mwo m where m.mwo_type = 'BM' and m.status in ('REQ', 'OPEN', 'WIP') and m.reported_at < #{to} and m.plant_cd = #{plantCd}
mapper.sql: from cms_equip_state_log s join mst_equip e on e.equip_id = s.equip_id left join cms_state_note n on n.state_log_id = s.state_log_id and n.void_yn = 'N' where s.start_at < #{to} and (s.end_at is null or s.end_at > #{from}) and s.reason_id is null and n.note_id is null and s.state_cat not in ('PRD', 'UNKNOWN') and e.plant_cd = #{plantCd}
mapper.select: select count(*) as pending_cnt, count(*) filter (where s.end_at is null) as open_cnt
